# Power model results (ESTIMATE, generated by power_model.py)

# Rev B: one CR2450

Circuit: one CR2450 -> P-MOSFET -> TPS63900 at 3.3 V (100 mA input limit), no output diode; input buffer 555 uF effective (85 uF MLCC + 470 uF electrolytic; 461 uF with the electrolytic at -20 %).
CR2450 resistances = CR2032 fit x 0.60 (electrode-area scaling, no published pulse data).

# Rev A: two CR2032 (record of decision D2)

Architectures: **A2** = diode-OR, 2 Schottky/cell, 1 converter 3.3 V (prompt default); **A1** = diode-OR, 1 Schottky/cell, 1 converter 3.3 V; **B** = 1 converter/cell 3.3 V, Schottky at each converter input; **C** = 1 converter/cell 3.4 V, P-MOSFET in, Schottky at each output (Rev A); **C50** = as C with 50 mA input current limit; **B0** = as B with P-MOSFET instead of Schottky (no 2nd barrier, reference)
